name: Glaucous-Threnody
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by magnetic pole anomalies. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in platinum here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
